policies.title: Deposits
policies.body: To secure your slot, please send a small deposit of K30 for nails, K50 for lashes. Your deposit is taken off your total price. It is non-refundable, but if you reschedule on time, I will move it to your new date. No deposit means no booking.

policies.title: Lateness
policies.body: Please arrive within 15 minutes of your time. If you are more than 15 minutes late, I may have to shorten your set or reschedule you, because the next client is waiting. Please just WhatsApp me if you are running late. I understand traffic and school.

policies.title: Cancellations
policies.body: Life happens, especially with school. Please tell me at least one day before if you cannot come. If you cancel the same day or do not show up, your deposit is lost. If you have exams or an emergency, message me and we will talk. I will try to help you reschedule.

policies.title: What to bring
policies.body: Come with clean nails, no old polish or old lashes if possible. Come with your inspo pictures, I love that! You are welcome to come with a friend if they are also getting a set done, or you can come alone if you can. My space is small but you will be comfortable. A full set takes 2 hours to 2 hours 30 minutes for nails, and 45 minutes for lashes. Please plan your time.

policies.title: Aftercare
policies.body: Do not wet your lashes for 24 hours. Do not pick your nails or lashes. If a nail breaks or a lash falls off within 3 days, message me. I will fix one or two for free for students.
